provenance.tool: property test; hand assignment of rate dates
provenance.steps: Market rates hand-constructed by a rule: eight month ends 2023-11-30 to 2024-06-30 (i = 0 to 7); EUR_SWAP_12M 0.030 + 0.001 i, EUR_SWAP_60M 0.025 + 0.0015 i, EUR_SWAP_120M 0.028 - 0.0005 i, the unconfigured EUR_OIS_36M 0.020 + 0.002 i, USD_SWAP_24M 0.045 - 0.001 i, USD_SWAP_120M 0.040 + 0.0005 i. With L = 1 (M4), the loan-month ending at t reads the curve at the previous month end (rate_dates, by hand). For each loan-month and each of the trials, every market row dated after t - L is dropped with probability drop_probability or given a rate drawn uniformly from [rate_low, rate_high] and rounded to 8 places, and rows for every series are added at each added month end; the incentive must be identical (==). Negative controls: shifting the configured rows at t - L by control_shift changes the incentive, and the same perturbation read with lag 0 changes it in at least one trial. Draws use one Python random.Random(seed): loan-months in fixture order; per trial, a drop draw then, if kept, a rate draw for each market row in fixture order, then one rate draw per added row, month ends in order and series sorted by (rate_id, currency, tenor_months). The property holds for any compounding convention of R, so no incentive value is asserted.
